hardware.windows: Intel Core i7-8700B, UHD 630 31.0.101.2140, Windows 11 build 26300, 1920x1080 59Hz

variants.groupedInputs: 150ms grouping of consecutive manual inputs, rejected
variants.asyncPosition: asynchronous mpv position commands and bounded settle polling, rejected
variants.beforeClockCheck: revisit, in-flight target reuse and shutdown fixes, original native-only completion
variants.chosen: beforeClockCheck plus native and published clock agreement on exact seek
variants.nativeComparison: the two Windows native output trials use the same intermediate host, decoder is the only requested change

metrics.freeze: longest observed unchanged frame after the last input, 2s observation window, milliseconds
metrics.firstTarget: null P95 if too many trials did not reach the target within 2s
metrics.avsync: absolute mpv A/V clock offset at end of observation, milliseconds
metrics.publishedSamples: per-trial values rounded to two decimals; distributions computed from the full precision input identified by SHA-256
metrics.closure: processExitMs percentiles cover exit code 0 only; validExits, withinBudget and positionPreserved show counts across all attempts
